title: Coverage recovery wave 01B — support evidence part 2
notes: Second tranche of the remaining Wave 01 targets under Issue #265. Adds bounded first-party support/maintenance evidence for 15 products. Yoroi is intentionally not treated as a normal supported product: its official site states that Yoroi and SecondFi are winding down after a security incident, so this bundle records that evidence without inventing an exact shutdown date. Canonical remains unchanged until validation/review and fresh-main promotion.

evidence.title: What Is the Binance Wallet and How to Use It?
evidence.notes: Current Binance Academy documentation describes Binance Wallet as a self-custodial wallet built into the Binance app, with active mobile and web flows and 2026 feature documentation. Supports active maintenance of the mobile wallet product.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Bitcoin.com Wallet page distributes the mobile app and documents active wallet functionality, supporting a maintained mobile product state.

evidence.title: Download the BitPay Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party BitPay download page distributes iOS and Android wallet builds and links active support, supporting current maintenance.

evidence.title: Coin98 Super Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Coin98 wallet page distributes iOS and Android mobile builds and a browser extension, supporting active maintenance of the mobile product.

evidence.title: MathWallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party MathWallet site distributes iPhone and Android builds and documents the multichain wallet product, supporting active maintenance.

evidence.title: Enkrypt
evidence.notes: Current first-party Enkrypt site distributes the extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Edge, Opera and Safari and describes ongoing multichain support.

evidence.title: Download Backpack
evidence.notes: Current first-party Backpack download page distributes the browser extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge, supporting an actively maintained extension product.

evidence.title: Official communication channels
evidence.notes: Current first-party Xaman help documentation links the latest Apple App Store and Google Play versions and the in-app support channel, supporting active maintenance of Xaman Mobile.

evidence.title: Pera Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party Pera site distributes Pera Mobile for iOS and Android and links current support and technical documentation, supporting active maintenance.

evidence.title: Yoroi and SecondFi are winding down
evidence.notes: Current official Yoroi site states that Yoroi and SecondFi are winding down following a security incident and directs users toward migration/recovery guidance. This is adverse lifecycle evidence and must not be converted into a normal supported-state claim. Exact shutdown date is not established by this page.

evidence.title: Download the Extension
evidence.notes: Current first-party Talisman documentation distributes the extension for Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge and documents current setup, supporting active maintenance.

evidence.title: Install SubWallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party SubWallet documentation provides active installation paths for Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox, with explicit Firefox maintenance caveats, supporting a maintained extension product.

evidence.title: Petra Wallet Terms of Use
evidence.notes: First-party Petra terms explicitly cover the Petra wallet application and browser extension. This evidence confirms the official product boundary; current support-state promotion should remain conservative unless paired with a current distribution surface.

evidence.title: Slush
evidence.notes: Current first-party Slush site distributes the browser extension, web app and mobile apps. Sui first-party documentation identifies Slush as the official wallet replacing Sui Wallet, supporting active maintenance of the extension product.

evidence.title: GridPlus SDK
evidence.notes: Official GridPlus organization repository for the SDK used to integrate with Lattice1; the repository is not archived. This supports continuing integration availability but is not by itself a full hardware support commitment, so promotion should remain conservative.
